items.text: in Auto play, the style tile has its own icon, particles in motion; the droplet is only ever color
wetness has its own icon, a sound and its echoes in a room, on the Sound shelf and in the Sound ring; the droplet is for color
in Pack, each sound's switch says whether it plays: a lit check when on, an empty ring when off, and an off sound's row dims
in Pack, the timing pill (every beat, eighths…) has its label, How often
on big windows the pills, tiles and beads in the shelves and panels were scaled up twice; they now grow once with the bar (a 72 px bar's pills are 48 px, not 64)
the In ring opened from the bar now has its switch on the bottom edge, the caret that lists the other rings, as it does on the stage
Capture's red dot means one thing, recording video. A GIF now shows a light dot with its loop arrow, like a still shows a light dot, so the button's icon always says what it will do
picking a water look or a part's color now ticks the Material path's color step
Water's colors are looks: Clear, Ink, Pool and Moonlight, each with a little preview of its colors. Tap one and the whole surface takes it
under the looks, fine-tune the tint (the water itself), the glint (the sparkle) and the caustic (the net of light), every choice a dot you can see: none, the lines, the second color or the ground
a pack can bring looks, credited to its author, and a pack of looks alone can be added from the Pack panel
the In ring's mic dot shows the mic as on when it was started from Sound, and a tap turns it off rather than the other way round
the In ring's camera dot shows one camera, not the camera and its flip icon on top of each other
opening the In ring from the bar no longer changes which ring a double-tap on the stage opens
screen readers hear the In button as expanded while its ring is open
in a panel's bottom band, the pin, back, next and close sit in the lower right corner again (the Pack panel had them by its tab)

adding a pack shows its sounds grouped by what they do, in plain words (Touch: plays when you touch the stage; On the beat; Bed: plays softly underneath, all the time; Pattern: follows the drawing), then Add or Cancel; any sound can be changed later under Your sounds
in the Pack panel, Import a file shows a page and Import a folder a folder, each with an arrow going in
the Field panel names itself at the top and wears its mark by its name in the band, like the other panels
each pack in the library wears a simple mark for what it holds (a sound, a drawing in code, a picture, a material), or its own cover, and names its author: Water by Dimitry Saïd Chamy

the In button on the bar wears the ring's mark and opens the In ring: camera, picture, video, mic, file, sound and pack, plus remove while a source is on. Its caret opens the In drawer as before, and a hold still opens the In shelf. The In ring is also one of the rings you can switch to on the stage
the Beats | Water switch under Sound wears its icons, the beat grid and the pack box, and each has a mark in its top right corner that opens its panel: Beats goes to the Beats tab, Water to the Pack
the Beat tab is now Beats

the gear on Auto play's Changes tiles is now a lighter mark, a dot in the tile's top right corner with a quarter arc around it; a swipe left from that corner still opens it. The Pro padlock moved to the top left
